description:
Ever had a computer chair or office chair that was no longer able to maintain its height?  There's a few DIY fixes that involve cutting PVC pipe and using metal clamps, but if you're like me, you probably would prefer a ready-made, out-of-the-box fix.  I found a cheap product that works!
